Milky Way Main Star.

Just three days had passed, and Lin Yuan’s Inner World had recovered to nearly two hundred million square miles in size.

The overwhelming force of the world, mixed with the power of more than two billion Spatial Layers, made even ordinary Tenth Rank Powerhouses feel fear.

“The Main Universe’s space is stable, countless Spatial Layers are equally firm…” thought Lin Yuan.

In the World of Gods, Lin Yuan could easily establish a stable ‘Martial Realm’ between many Spatial Layers, destined for all Martial Spirits to ascend.

...

But in the Main Universe, Lin Yuan was unable to do so. The space in the Main Universe was too stable. Even Tenth Rank Powerhouses couldn’t force open a world of their own, it would take at least a Tier 11.

And the worlds created by Eleventh Rank Powerhouses could not last forever. Without maintenance, they would gradually be restored by the Main Universe’s innate repairing capabilities.

Unless one reached the level of a Supreme Being with the power to cause Eternal Spatial Rifts, the idea of carving out a stable ‘Martial Realm’ in the Main Universe was almost a fantasy.

“However, these past few days, the hottest topic in Human Civilization must be the Martial Path Evolutionary Path…”

Lin Yuan connected his consciousness to the virtual network, where the headlines of all major media in Human Civilization were all about the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Before the Ninth Rank Chapter of the Martial Arts Evolutionary Path was uploaded, even if it was only the Eighth Layer Part, even if it topped the Annan Star Alliance leaderboard, it was still considered a minor Evolution Path within the scope of Human Civilization.

Annan Star Alliance? It is merely one of the countless Star Alliances within the territory of Human Civilization.

No matter how astoundingly fast the Martial Path Evolutionary Path soared, the vast majority of Human Civilization’s Evolvers and citizens had still never heard of it.

But when the Ninth Rank Martial Path Evolutionary Path suddenly jumped onto the Southern Star Region evolutionary leaderboard, it could be said to have ‘completely broken into the mainstream.’

There are many regions like the Annan Star Alliance within the Human Alliance, but Star Regions? There are only five major Star Regions in the entirety of Human Civilization.

The Star Region level evolutionary leaderboards receive attention from countless human Evolvers every day.

The changes in the Southern Star Region evolutionary leaderboard, even if it was only by fifty-three spots, or even a hundred, would stir discussions across all levels of Human Civilization.

“That’s a good thing.”

“The ‘breaking into the mainstream’ of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the number of Evolvers practicing the Martial Path Evolutionary Path…”

Lin Yuan looked pleased as he simultaneously opened the numerical information of Evolvers of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

The rule in Human Civilization is that every citizen who becomes an Evolver must register at the local Evolver’s Association.

Lin Yuan himself had once registered with the Evolver’s Association on Canglan Star.

By registering, detailed information about each Evolver is collected, which then allows for the calculation of the number of Martial Arts Evolutionaries at each rank.

“First Tier Chapter: Sixty-nine billion, five hundred and sixty-three million, four hundred and twelve thousand.”

“Second Layer Chapter: Nine billion, two hundred and fifty million, four hundred and thirty thousand.”

“Third Rank Chapter: One hundred and ninety-six million, five hundred thousand.”

“Fourth Rank Chapter: Five million, four hundred and twenty thousand.”

“Fifth Stage Section: Eight hundred and twelve thousand.”

“Sixth Rank Chapter: Ninety-eight thousand.”

“Seventh Rank Chapter: Two thousand six hundred and seventy-three.”

“Eighth Layer Part: Zero.”

…

Lin Yuan glanced over the relevant data and nodded slightly.

It was clear that between the Second Layer Chapter and the Third Rank Chapter, there was a huge drop in the number of practitioners.

This wasn’t because the probability of breaking through from the Martial Dao Second Layer to the Martial Dao Third Rank was too low, but rather, at least half of the numbers for the First Tier Chapter and Second Layer Chapter had been added in these past few days.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path ranking at fifty-three on the Star Region level evolutionary leaderboard brought such immense ‘exposure’ to all of humanity, no one knew how many citizens had chosen to practice the Martial Path.

Moreover, the transition from the First Tier Chapter to the Second Layer Chapter could be ‘fast-tracked’ in some way, as it was related to the accumulation of energy.

As for advancing from the Second Layer to the Third Rank, that was much more difficult.

“Progressing along a stable evolutionary path makes for a very high efficiency and speed,” Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

How many years had it been since the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was uploaded? In the Main World, only a hundred years had passed, and yet, there were already over two thousand Martial Dao Seventh Rankers.

Keep in mind… When Lin Yuan first created the Martial Dao chapters from the First Rank to the Seventh Rank, including the years spent traveling between worlds, it had taken him a thousand years.

Of course, Lin Yuan was aware that those who had cultivated to Martial Dao Seventh Rank within a century were generally High-Rank Evolvers who had switched paths.

Many Sixth Rank and Seventh Rank Evolvers, foreseeing the potential of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, had paid a huge price to forsake their original Evolution Path and choose the Martial Path instead.

High-Rank Evolvers retraining in the Martial Path had a mastery of the essential nature of power and rules, allowing them to advance rapidly in the early and middle stages without needing any additional insights.

“These years’ share of profits…” Lin Yuan glanced at his account balance – about nine million Cubic Universe Crystals.

This is Cubic Universe Crystal, not civilizational currency or Universe Currency, but the Cosmic Crystal used universally by many races across the universe.

Normally, a Eighth Layer Powerhouse’s worth is between a few thousand to ten thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

Lin Yuan’s shared income over the past twenty or thirty years was equivalent to the wealth accumulated by over a thousand Eighth Layer Powerhouses in more than half their lifetimes.

“Nine million Cubic Universe Crystals, four million of which came from the past few days. The Ninth Rank Chapter’s price is five hundred trillion civilizational currency, equivalent to five Cubic Universe Crystals,” he thought.

“With four million Cubic Universe Crystals in shared income, the total sales are roughly around twelve million Cubic Universe Crystals, which means these past few days, the Ninth Rank Chapter was purchased two to three million times…”

Lin Yuan was somewhat astonished. There were indeed many tycoons in Human Civilization, and the means by which High-Rank Evolvers amassed wealth were quite terrifying.

“Nearly ten million Cubic Universe Crystals in shared income, and it will only increase in the future…” Lin Yuan became increasingly aware of the earning speed of a High-Rank Evolutionary Path founder.
